title: Semantic Text Classifier & Retriever
description: Build a semantic text pipeline that classifies documents and retrieves the top-k passages for a query: TF-IDF and embedding baselines, a fixed evaluation set with labelled relevance judgments, and an honest comparison report.
learningObjectives: Tokenize and vectorize text with both sparse and dense representations
Build a small, fixed evaluation set with relevance judgments
Compare TF-IDF and embedding retrieval with precision@k and MRR
Explain qualitative differences between the retrievers with examples

milestones.title: Corpus + evaluation set
milestones.objective: Assemble a public corpus and hand-label at least 20 query→relevant-passage judgments.
milestones.expectedOutput: Judgment file committed with the queries it covers.

milestones.title: Two retrievers
milestones.objective: Implement TF-IDF retrieval and embedding (cosine) retrieval over the same chunking.
milestones.expectedOutput: An index module returning ranked results for both methods.

milestones.title: Measure with precision@k / MRR
milestones.objective: Evaluate both retrievers on the fixed judgment set; record precision@k and MRR.

milestones.title: Qualitative comparison
milestones.objective: Pick two queries where methods disagree; explain why with text evidence.
milestones.expectedOutput: Short analysis section in the report.

categories.minimumExpectation: Both retrievers run end-to-end on the fixed corpus
categories.excellentExpectation: Deterministic chunk IDs across runs plus edge-case chunks

categories.minimumExpectation: At least 20 judgments with per-method metrics
categories.excellentExpectation: Judgment protocol documented and disagreements hand-audited

criteria: Same chunker and queries for both
No tuning on the judged set
categories.excellentExpectation: Held-out sanity check or second judgment round
Walkthrough of one query through both retrievers

criteria: Unit tests for vectorization and metrics

architecture: corpus ingestion → chunker → two indexer backends → evaluator
Queries and judgments live in versioned files
constraints: Same chunker for both retrieval methods
hints: Keep judgments small but honest; hand-labelling teaches more than large scraped relevance sets

requiredEvidence.description: Repository with corpus, retrievers, and evaluator.
